say.variants.default: Hold up a second. You're still breathing—that's a good start.
Hey there. Easy with your hands—who's out on this road?
say.variants.positive: Thank goodness, a living face. Steady now, I'm not looking for a fight.
Hey—good to see someone else still standing around here.
say.variants.neutral: Stop right there a moment. Just passing through this block?
Keep your hands where I can see them and tell me what brings you by.
say.variants.negative: Stay back a step. I don't know you, and folks out here get jumpy fast.
Don't crowd me. State what you want from right where you're standing.
say.variants.contextual: Quiet street to be walking alone. You scavenging these houses or looking for someone?
Didn't expect to cross paths with anyone on this side of town.
entries.reply.blocked.say.variants.negative: Back off—this isn't the time to talk.
entries.reply.welcomed.say.variants.default: All right, you seem decent enough. Watch the side alleys out here.
entries.reply.welcomed.say.variants.positive: Glad we didn't jump the gun, {addressee.name}. Good to know there's still decent folks left.
entries.reply.cautious.say.variants.default: Fair enough. You mind your business, I'll mind mine.
entries.reply.cautious.say.variants.neutral: All right. Keep your weapon low and we won't have a problem.
entries.reply.cautious.say.variants.contextual: Just keep your eyes on the treeline if you're heading down that road.
entries.reply.declined.say.variants.negative: Then we're done talking. Move along before you draw the dead.
entries.reply.evasive.say.variants.default: Keep your secrets if you want. Just don't bring trouble my way.
entries.reply.evasive.say.variants.neutral: Fine, no names needed. Stay safe out there.
